description: Refused a progress report, and kept the six days.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Complained of the hem, and stood where he was told.
name: Arthur Meeks

description: Finished the cuff, and restated payment on delivery.
name: Edith Kettlewood

description: Accepted the length, and kept the fee unspent and unseen.
name: John Heminges

description: Separated today's still house from Tuesday's thin one, and gave no new box.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Said the yard heard every word, and refused a new sum.
name: William Shakespeare
